facts.text: Italiano Ristorante is on the top floor, serving Italian dishes and wines with a view over the city center.
facts.excerpt: Located on the top floor of the hotel, diners can expect a tantalizing epicurean experience with Italian flair a at Italiano Ristorante which attracts with its choice of Italian dishes, collection of wines and amazing view to the city center.

facts.text: Gabriel's Patisserie on Abovyan Street offers French and Armenian confections.
facts.excerpt: Gabriel’s Patisserie on Abovyan Street offers elegant French and Armenian confections.

facts.text: The Keys Cigar Lounge has displays of wines, high-end spirits and cigars, suited to private gatherings.
facts.excerpt: Attractive displays of wines and high-end spirits, as well as finest cigars compose an incomparable place in the city for executive meetings, important gatherings and for those who value ambiance of privacy and high-level comfort.

facts.text: Gabriel's Bar and Lounge serves small bites, pastries, locally inspired drinks, coffees and teas.
facts.excerpt: A classic yet modern selection comprises small bites, pastries, locally inspired drinks, and hot and cold coffees and teas.

facts.text: Alexander Spa by Anne Semonin features the French skincare house, with bespoke treatments and skincare rituals.
facts.excerpt: Alexander Spa by Anne Semonin, an exclusive sanctuary featuring the prestigious French skincare house. The spa offers bespoke treatments, advanced skincare rituals and a deeply personalized wellness journey
